tagline: The quieter royal-coast resort beach, ~14 nm up from Hua Hin.
summary: Cha-Am is a long, laid-back resort beach in Phetchaburi, ~14 nm north of Hua Hin on Thailand's royal coast. It draws a steady domestic weekend crowd from Bangkok and anchors a string of beachfront resorts. As a Royal Coast node it pairs with Hua Hin: a short, sheltered coastal foiling hop links the two resort fronts and feeds the cross-Gulf line.

demand_signals.detail: Strong Bangkok weekend demand to the Cha-Am/Hua Hin beach strip.
A continuous run of resorts along the Cha-Am front anchors premium transfer demand.
Pairs with Hua Hin as the northern node of the royal-coast resort cluster.

use_cases: Hua Hin <-> Cha-Am coastal resort hop
Weekend leisure shuttle from the Hua Hin hub
navier_fit: Moderate-to-high as a resort spur on the Royal Coast; the short sheltered hop is a clean Pioneer II leg. Demand is resort-driven; survey berth/charging at the Cha-Am front.
competitive_landscape: Coastal road transfer only; no premium water option between the royal-coast resorts.
seasonality: Peak: Nov-Apr cool/dry; this stretch of the upper Gulf is relatively sheltered, broadening the operating window.
regulatory_note: Thai Marine Department licensing; Phetchaburi provincial coordination for pier use.

precedents.label: Cha-Am/Hua Hin resort corridor
precedents.note: Established domestic resort demand a premium hop can serve.

grab.wedge: Short premium coastal hop linking the royal-coast resort fronts, feeding the cross-Gulf line to Pattaya.
